question: Who among the following is the author of the novel ‘Tamas’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bhisham Sahni__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The author of the novel 'Tamas' is Bhisham Sahni.
 
• 'Tamas' is a significant work in Hindi literature, dealing with the partition of India in 1947.
 
• The novel portrays the communal violence that erupted in the wake of partition, based on a true story from Sahni's own experiences.
 
• Bhisham Sahni was not only a prolific writer but also a playwright, actor, and translator, contributing greatly to Hindi literature and theatre.
 
• 'Tamas' has been adapted into a television film by the same name, directed by Govind Nihalani.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Work
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Tamas**
 A novel set against the backdrop of the partition of India, highlighting the human cost of communal strife.
 
 

 Literary Contributions
 Bhisham Sahni's works often reflect his deep understanding of social issues and his commitment to secular and humanist ideals.
 
 

 Awards
 For his literary contributions, Bhisham Sahni was awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award, in 1998.
 
 

 Themes
 His works frequently explore themes of communal harmony, social injustice, and human dignity.
 
 

 Legacy
 Bhisham Sahni's legacy in Hindi literature is monumental, with 'Tamas' being a landmark novel that continues to be studied and appreciated.
